results.title: Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Shipping & Logistics
results.description: The Chief Operating Officer (COO) will be a key member of the executive leadership team and will have overall responsibility for driving operational performance, service excellence, productivity, efficiency and sustainable growth across the logistics operations. The COO will provide strategic and operational leadership across the company's integrated logistics platform, covering Freight Forwarding – Sea, Air and Land, Procurement, Customs Clearance, Yard Management, Land Transportation and Fleet, Service Centers, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI), Warehousing and Contract Logistics. Working closely with the CEO and other members of the leadership team, the COO will translate the company's strategy into effective operating plans, establish consistent operating standards, strengthen cross-functional integration and ensure that the organization is positioned for scalable and profitable growth. The role carries significant responsibility for operational and financial performance, with partial P&L accountability, while maintaining a strong focus on customer retention, operational excellence, digital transformation, business expansion and organizational capability. The successful candidate will be expected to build a high-performance operating culture, improve utilization of people and assets, enhance customer experience, strengthen governance and controls, and continuously identify opportunities to improve the company's competitive position. Key Responsibilities: Overall Operations Leadership: Lead and oversee all UAE operational activities across Sea, Air and Land Freight Forwarding, Procurement, Customs Clearance, Yard Management, Land Transportation & Fleet, Service Centers, PDI, Warehousing and Contract Logistics. Operational Strategy: Develop and execute the UAE operations strategy in alignment with the company's overall business objectives and growth plans. Operational Excellence: Drive continuous improvement, standardization, productivity, efficiency and cost optimization across all operational functions. Integrated Operations: Ensure seamless coordination and integration between freight forwarding, customs, transportation, fleet, yards, warehouses, PDI and contract logistics to deliver end-to-end logistics solutions. Financial Performance: Take partial P&L responsibility for operations, with accountability for operating costs, productivity, margins, budgets and efficient utilization of resources and assets. Customer Retention & Service Excellence: Drive operational service quality and customer retention by ensuring consistent service delivery, timely resolution of operational issues and strong performance against customer commitments. Business Transformation: Lead operational transformation initiatives, including process re-engineering, automation, digitalization and data-driven performance management. Growth & Expansion: Support the CEO in identifying and implementing opportunities for business expansion, new services, capacity development, strategic partnerships and operational investments. Fleet & Asset Optimization: Maximize utilization and productivity of fleet, equipment, facilities, yards, warehouses and other operational assets while maintaining appropriate maintenance and safety standards. Procurement & Supplier Management: Provide strategic oversight of operational procurement and supplier performance, ensuring competitive sourcing, cost efficiency, service quality and strong supplier governance. Performance Management: Establish and monitor operational KPIs, dashboards and performance-management routines, ensuring clear accountability and timely corrective action across all operational departments. Risk, Compliance & HSE: Ensure operations comply with applicable UAE regulations, customer requirements and company policies, with strong focus on safety, security, risk management and business continuity. People & Leadership: Lead, coach and develop the operational leadership team, building a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, customer service and continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with the CEO, Finance, Commercial, HR, IT and other functions to ensure effective execution of the company's strategic and operational priorities. Executive Reporting: Provide the CEO and executive leadership team with regular reporting and insights on operational performance, financial results, customer issues, risks, opportunities and strategic initiatives. Key Requirements: Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Maritime Studies, Operations Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 15 to 25 Years Experience in Supply Chain Management. Executive leadership certifications and professional memberships are advantageous. Experience managing large-scale, multi-site, or multi-country operations is highly desirable. GCC/UAE experience preferred. Personal Attributes: Visionary and entrepreneurial leader. Results-oriented with a strong commercial mindset. Highly proactive and resilient. Strong executive presence and communication skills. Exceptional interpersonal and stakeholder management capabilities. Able to lead through change and drive business transformation. High integrity, professionalism, and accountability.

results.title: Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles
results.description: 🚛 Hiring: Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles | Kuwait We are recruiting on behalf of a well-established automotive and commercial vehicle organisation in Kuwait for an experienced Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles to lead its service and workshop operations. This is a senior operational role responsible for driving workshop performance, service quality, profitability, team productivity and customer satisfaction. Key Responsibilities: • Manage the overall Commercial Vehicle Service & Workshop operation , ensuring efficient workflow and productivity. • Lead and manage service advisors, technicians, workshop personnel and support teams. • Monitor workshop productivity, utilisation, repair quality and turnaround times . • Ensure vehicles are completed and delivered on time while maintaining manufacturer and service standards. • Manage escalated customer issues and ensure effective resolution. • Monitor and improve service revenue, labour sales, parts consumption, warranty performance and workshop profitability . • Plan workshop manpower, tools, equipment and capacity according to business requirements. • Drive continuous improvement across workshop operations and customer service. Candidate Requirements: • Minimum 8–10 years' experience within automotive or commercial vehicle service/workshop operations. • Proven experience as a Service Manager, Workshop Manager or similar leadership role . • Strong preference for candidates with experience in commercial vehicles, trucks, buses or heavy-duty vehicles . • Strong knowledge of workshop operations, productivity and service KPIs. • Demonstrable experience managing and developing workshop/service teams. • Commercial understanding of service revenue, labour, parts, warranty and profitability. • Strong customer management and problem-solving skills. • Must currently be based in Kuwait and available for local recruitment. • Transferable Kuwait residency preferred. 📍 Location: Kuwait 🚛 Sector: Automotive / Commercial Vehicles 💼 Position: Service Manager – Commercial Vehicles If you have strong commercial vehicle workshop management experience and are currently based in Kuwait, please apply.

results.title: Sr. Manager Logistics Operations
results.description: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. Job Description WHAT’S ON YOUR PLATE? Lead Talabat Qatar’s overall supply ecosystem, ensuring a sustainable, high-quality, and high-performing rider base across the country. Develop and execute the overall supply growth and acquisition strategy aligned with business demand and market dynamics. Lead long-term supply forecasting and planning to ensure full coverage and service level adherence. Identify and launch new supply channels such as female riders, refugees, micro-financing, and e-bikes to diversify and sustain fleet growth. Manage the full lifecycle of 3PL partnerships, from selection and onboarding to performance management and contract renewals. Set clear KPIs and SLAs for 3PL partners, ensuring compliance, efficiency, and rider quality. Build and maintain strong strategic relationships with key 3PL partners to drive alignment and operational excellence. Lead and manage the on-ground operations team to ensure smooth daily operations, compliance, and service quality. Monitor and improve key operational KPIs including rider supply rate, EPH, order-on-time percentage, and churn rate. Implement standardized processes and digital tools to enhance control, visibility, and scalability across operations. Coach and develop a high-performing team of managers, seniors, and specialists across supply, 3PLs, and operations. Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team. Work closely with cross-functional teams such as People, Finance, Commercial, and Product to align on strategies and deliverables. Identify and implement process improvements and best practices to enhance efficiency and rider satisfaction. Drive automation and technology-enabled initiatives to improve visibility and performance management. Oversee equipment management including uniforms, delivery boxes, and e-bikes to ensure consistent quality and operational standards. Ensure adherence to performance KPIs such as supply run rate, rider churn and retention, 3PL compliance, rider NPS, EPH, and operational coverage. Build long-term plans to sustain growth and strengthen Talabat’s market leadership position. Qualifications WHAT DID WE ORDER? Bachelor’s degree required, with a preference for majors in Logistics, Supply Chain, Operations, or equivalent work experience in compliance or auditing Minimum of 5 years of experience in operational roles within fast-paced environments. Track record in the FoodTech logistics sector is a plus. Management consulting experience is also considered a significant advantage Management experience is advantageous, with the ability to effectively manage direct reports and foster a strong team culture. Strong problem-solving abilities, with the capacity to dig into detail, manage complexity, and drive decision-making Advanced proficiency in GSheet, demonstrating a strong analytical skill set. Ability to reason analytically, logically, and in a consistent fashion Strong English written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging across a diverse set of stakeholders, Arabic is good to have but not necessary Extremely organized and process-driven, with a proven ability to manage a heavy workload effectively by setting priorities and managing expectations well Able to travel to all talabat markets as needed.

results.title: Team Leader , Logistics
results.description: About noon We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East—fast, scalable, and deeply customer-centric. Our mission is to deliver to every door every day. We want to redefine what technology can do in this region, and we’re looking for a Team Leader, Logistics who can help us move even faster. Noon’s fastest hyper-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localised assortment of FMCG & grocery products with delivery within 15 minutes. Currently live across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time. noon’s mission: Every door, every day. What you’ll do: Effectively manage the assigned fleet across 3-5 Dark Stores within the cluster, consistently meeting target KPIs. Supervise Fleet Managers, overseeing daily operations to ensure the smooth and efficient execution of fleet activities. Ensure rigorous adherence to Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and compliance with all operational standards. Support efficient manpower allocation across all stores in the cluster Mentor and guide the team, fostering high performance and proactively addressing operational challenges. Maintain clear, timely, and effective communication with all stakeholders to ensure complete operational alignment. What you’ll need: Minimum 2 years of experience in Logistics, managing teams. Excellent communication and coordination skills. A hands-on approach—willing to roll up your sleeves and get involved. Comfortable working in highly ambiguous situations and adapting to change. Understanding of logistics metrics and ability to manage stakeholders effectively. Flexibility in work schedule to accommodate operational needs. Who will excel? We’re looking for people with high standards who understand that hard work matters. You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action. We need people with the courage to be fiercely original. noon is not for everyone; readiness to adapt, pivot, and learn is essential.

results.title: Delivery Operations Lead
results.description: About the Role We are looking for a hands-on Delivery Operations Lead to take ownership of daily last-mile delivery operations in Qatar. You will personally coordinate dispatch, plan routes, track driver activity, and resolve delivery issues. You will also improve driver productivity, establish clear procedures, and maintain accurate visibility over every order. working closely with the store team, customer service, drivers and external delivery providers. Key Responsibilities Execute daily dispatch, assign orders to drivers and plan efficient routes based on location, priority and agreed delivery timelines. Monitor driver movement, availability and workload, adjusting assignments as new orders arrive. Follow each order from pickup through delivery confirmation, unsuccessful delivery or return. Identify delays, unnecessary trips, waiting time and uneven workloads, and implement practical improvements. Plan driver coverage with delivery providers and arrange additional capacity during peak periods. Review driver punctuality, delivery results, customer complaints and compliance; coordinate corrective action or replacement with providers when required. Create and implement SOPs for pickup, customer contact, delivery confirmation, failed deliveries, returns and cash handover. Maintain accurate dispatch records, timestamps, proof of delivery and reasons for unsuccessful attempts. Follow up with drivers, store administration and Finance to confirm cash and returned-product handovers and resolve outstanding discrepancies. Provide daily delivery summaries and weekly analysis covering delivery completion, delays, driver productivity and improvement actions. Qualifications At least three years of experience in last-mile delivery, courier dispatch or e-commerce delivery operations. Proven experience directly coordinating drivers, allocating orders, planning routes and resolving delivery problems. Good knowledge of Qatar’s roads and delivery areas. Experience coordinating external delivery providers and additional drivers during peak periods. Practical experience improving dispatch procedures and driver performance. Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets, digital maps and delivery tracking tools. Understanding of cash-on-delivery controls, proof of delivery and returns procedures. Strong communication, organization, problem-solving and follow-up skills. Strong English communication skills; Arabic is an advantage. Ready to join immediately in Qatar. How to Apply Send your CV to career@arkanmktg.com. Briefly describe the number of drivers and daily deliveries you have coordinated, along with an operational improvement you personally implemented. Subject: Delivery Operations Lead

Based in Dubai, UAE, you will play a key role in shaping our logistics strategy and enhancing our brand's reputation in the highly competitive e-commerce market. RESPONSIBILITIES: Management of the logistics processes in the Middle East Lead warehousing, transportation, and distribution operations: supervise warehouses, control the movement of goods within the region, and ensure timely and accurate product delivery to customers Strategic decision-making Develop and manage the logistics budget, ensuring cost-effectiveness and adherence to financial targets Employee development and training, improving employees’ qualification and boosting motivation Analyze and research customer needs to develop the optimal approach for meeting them REQUIREMENTS: Higher education in Logistics or a related field 5-7 years of management experience in logistics and supply chain management within FMCG, beauty, fashion, or pharmaceuticals, with a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role Fluency in English (both spoken and written), Arabic – as an advantage Deep industry expertise in transportation, warehousing (WMS), inventory management, distribution, and order fulfillment Experience in B2C e-commerce Hands-on experience working with 3PL partners (managing tenders, evaluating KPIs, system integration) Project experience (cost optimization, system integration, etc.) will be an an advantage

results.title: Logistics & Mobility Director
results.description: MARAFID is the execution arm of Riyadh Holding Company, specializing in the development and activation of economic infrastructure across three core sectors: Logistics & Mobility, Industrial Clusters, and Circular Economy. We bring together development, asset management, leasing, and strategic partnerships to translate these sectors into projects and services that support business activity and serve the needs of operators, tenants, and investors. Our focus spans logistics parks, truck stations, parking facilities, specialized industrial hubs, and infrastructure for material aggregation, reuse, and recycling. Digital solutions and shared services support the management of these assets and their connections with the businesses they serve. Through collaboration with public and private sector partners, MARAFID connects land, infrastructure, and operational expertise to support Riyadh’s economic growth. We are currently seeking a Logistics & Mobility Director to manage and coordinate MARAFID’s logistics and mobility ecosystem operations, overseeing sector assets, services, and ecosystem participants to ensure effective service delivery, operational performance, and sustainable growth of the sector. 1. Key Responsibilities Oversee logistics and mobility ecosystem operations, coordinating activities across MARAFID’s relevant assets, facilities, services, and sector initiatives. Manage the operational performance of sector assets and services, monitoring utilization, service levels, revenues, costs, and other key operational indicators. Coordinate with operators, tenants, service providers, and ecosystem partners to ensure effective integration and delivery of services across the logistics and mobility ecosystem. Identify and implement operational improvement opportunities to enhance asset utilization, service quality, efficiency, customer experience, and overall ecosystem performance. Support the launch and operationalization of new logistics and mobility offerings, ensuring the effective transition of new projects and services into ongoing operations. Monitor sector demand, customer needs, and operational trends to identify opportunities to enhance existing services and inform future ecosystem development. Coordinate with relevant corporate functions to support effective and compliant operations. 2. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related field. 7+ years of relevant experience in logistics, mobility, operations, asset management, service delivery, or a related field. Strong understanding of operational performance, service delivery, asset utilization, and key operational indicators. Strong stakeholder management, coordination, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Fluency in Arabic and English.
